findings.rationale: Correct: a module-level Set is shared by engine instances in one process. Folded (phase 2 step 2): ownership is per instance (this.ownedTempDirs bound in the constructor); dispose and finish() touch only this instance's set.

Correct: a hung live owner can outlive a wall-time-based retention. Folded (phase 2 step 4, phase 3 step 2): runtime scratch dirs carry .autopilot-owner {pid,start_time}; prune keeps any dir whose owner is alive with the same start time, regardless of age; KR4 tests it.

Correct. Folded (phase 4 step 1a/2): the registry is the only registration source; the gate itself fails when _SRR_PATTERNS differs from the registry's test-lockgated entries, on pre-commit and preflight; KR5 self-test plants a reaper-only prefix.

Correct within reason: a recognizer limited to allocation calls misses /tmp literals and helpers. Folded (phase 4 step 1): an occurrence is any textual temp-root reference (os.tmpdir(), $TMPDIR/${TMPDIR, '/tmp/' literals, mkdtemp/mktemp); helpers that only resolve the root are allowlisted with a reason; KR5 plants a bare /tmp/ literal. Indirection through runtime-computed paths remains caught at the helper that references the root.

Correct. Folded: KR1 runs under bash -c 'set -e' with --fail-on-entries; every phase's acceptance is now only its KR command(s) plus the full suite; the vague real-host run and wiring-only checks are no longer acceptance.
Correct. Folded (§4 dependency map, phase 1 step 2): the registry file and tmp-residue.js core (patterns, new-since) land first in phase 1; phases 2-4 depend on phase 1.
Correct: the reaper lock-gates only a dir holding its own sidecar. Folded (phase 1 step 5): TEST_SHORT_TMP=/tmp/apt.XXXXXX carries its own .autopilot-live.lock held by the same holder process.

Correct. Folded (KR1): new-since lists every current-user direct child newer than the stamp, labelled by registry kind or unregistered; --exclude-kind removes only named kinds, so worktree and unregistered leaks are always reported.
Correct; same root as finding 2 (accepted blocker, one fold): one registration source, gate-enforced parity, phase 3 inventory includes lock and test-lockgated kinds.

Correct: rule text and negative control disagreed. Folded (phase 4 step 1b): allocation must be the first statement inside the try; 'immediately before' removed, so the planted allocation-before-try fixture fails under the rule.
